name: Bane

targets.description: creatures of your choice that you can see

summary: Up to three creatures fail a Charisma save and subtract 1d4 from their attack rolls and saving throws.
text: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range each make a Charisma saving throw. Until the spell ends, each creature that failed subtracts 1d4 from every attack roll and saving throw it makes. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: you can target one more creature for each slot level above 1.
